description: JavaScript source code for TinyMCE table plugin, defining plugin info, control HTML, command execution, and node change handling.

classes.name: TinyMCE_TablePlugin
classes.description: Object containing methods for table plugin functionality in TinyMCE, including info retrieval, initialization, command execution, and node change handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes plugin instance, adds event handlers if Gecko engine.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for control buttons based on control name.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes specified table-related commands in the editor.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Updates UI controls based on current node selection in the editor.

methods.name: _mouseDownHandler
methods.description: Handles mouse down events for visual aid updates.

methods.name: _doExecCommand
methods.description: Performs detailed execution of table commands like insert, delete, merge, and split cells.
